milestones.title: Trains, and the first packages on NuGet
points: Trains: typed chains of small steps
Every run recorded, in Postgres or in memory
A mediator that runs a train from its input type
A scheduler, an operations dashboard and project templates
Analyzers and a Rider plugin that check a chain as you write it

milestones.title: The CLI
points: A new project from a template
Trains generated from an OpenAPI or GraphQL schema

milestones.title: A GraphQL API for trains
points: A typed mutation for each train, to run it or queue it
Lifecycle events as subscriptions
Entity queries with filtering, sorting and paging
Authorization on each train
One AddTrax builder, checked at startup

milestones.title: Workers anywhere
points: Runs handed to remote HTTP workers
Jobs submitted through SQS and run on AWS Lambda
Dispatch retried with backoff, and requeued when it fails
Runs left behind by a dead worker are reaped

milestones.title: Scheduling
points: Six-field cron, misfire policies and jitter
Delayed one-off jobs and calendar exclusion windows
Cancellation and run timeouts
Per-train and global concurrency limits
Dead letters, requeue and retry backoff

milestones.title: SQLite and authentication
points: A SQLite data provider
API keys, JWT and OIDC
An audit trail of API calls
The caller passed to the steps of a train

milestones.title: Persisted operations
points: Asynchronous chains end to end
Persisted GraphQL operations, managed from the dashboard
One operations service behind the dashboard and GraphQL
Cognito, and several JWT schemes at once
Live updates over SignalR
A typed .NET GraphQL client

milestones.title: Guards
points: Test packages that fail the build when the architecture drifts
Every GraphQL surface must say who may call it
A hook that runs when a train is queued

milestones.title: State machines
points: Machines written in C#, with a TypeScript twin
Declarative rules exported as one portable description
The twin generated from it by the CLI
Both runtimes checked against each other on a shared corpus
A runtime self check at startup

milestones.title: Hardening
points: Owner-scoped queries, checked at startup
Sensitive values masked in stored inputs and outputs
Signed requests between the scheduler and its runners
Retention set per train
Architecture decision records, and the docs served as llms.txt

milestones.title: Recorded decisions, and one repository
points: The decisions a run makes are recorded
Requeues and retries replay them
A step-by-step timeline on every run
Every dashboard action also in GraphQL
One repository, one version for every package
